nina: Quick one for offboarding checklist — former employee wants to roll their 401k to an IRA and elect HSA COBRA. Which docs do we require from the employee and what do we need from the plan vendor?

harry: For 401k -> IRA: signed distribution/rollover election (direct trustee-to-trustee preferred). Proof of IRA account is needed (acceptance letter or PDF statement). If they already got a check made out to them, that's an indirect rollover (60-day rule) and that has different tax handling.

elaine: HSA side: signed COBRA election form (within 60 days of qualifying event) and payment method for COBRA premiums. We also need the vendor to confirm the COBRA effective date and a ledger of employer contributions so payroll can reconcile.

nina: Is a screenshot from the IRA portal acceptable as "proof"? And do we accept e-signed vendor forms?

harry: Screenshot is acceptable only if it clearly shows the account holder name, custodian, and account number (partial ok) with a visible date/time or email header. Prefer official PDF/email from custodian. E-signatures are fine if executed via DocuSign/HelloSign for our forms; vendor acceptance varies but most take e-sign.

elaine: Add this to the offboard packet checklist and flag payroll to tag the final pay so pre-tax HSA deferrals reconcile. I'll paste the checklist below.

elaine: ```
Offboard checklist (401k + HSA):
- Employee-signed 401k distribution/rollover election (direct rollover recommended)
- Proof of IRA account (PDF stmt or acceptance email; dated screenshot acceptable in a pinch)
- If a cash check was issued: record date/amount (employee has 60 days to roll over)
- Signed HSA COBRA election form (within 60 days)
- Payment method for COBRA premiums (ACH/card)
- Vendor confirmations: rollover processing status, COBRA effective date, breakdown of last employer HSA contributions
- Payroll flag on final run to show contribution buckets for reconciliation
```

nina: One more edge case: employee says they received a small distribution and deposited it into an IRA already. Should we ask for proof of deposit?

harry: Yes ask for a dated IRA statement showing the deposit and note the source (plan name). If withholding occurred, payroll can't undo it; employee may need to claim refund on their tax return. We can supply vendor contact/email for tax questions.

elaine: I'll attach vendor form templates and update the offboard Notion page. Tag INT-4890 for follow-ups.

nina: Thanks — I'll include this in the offboarding email to the manager and close INT-4890 when complete. :thumbsup:
